Try to snap it in two
Try to snap it in two
You almost never can.
It usually breaks into
three or more.
In slow motion,
the first break makes
the pieces snap back.
That sends a bending
wave down the strand,
and it breaks again.
Researchers at MIT found
a fix.
Twist it almost a full
turn first.
Then bend it slowly.
Now it usually snaps in two.
It takes a few tries.
Try it tonight.
